mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is negative: as FEDFUNDS decreases, returns increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market weakness and potential economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017 base) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals deteriorating economic conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900 (thousands of units), it signals weak housing demand and broader economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 900, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017 base), it signals supply contraction and economic weakening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 230 (1982-1984=100), it signals inflationary pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) falls below 136000 (thousands of persons), it signals labor market weakness and potential economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS < 136000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
